idioms: Follow the client's .editorconfig and existing namespace/file layout; never introduce a new style.
Use nullable reference types if the project enables <Nullable>enable</Nullable>.
Prefer async/await with CancellationToken parameters on public async APIs.
Use the client's DI container registrations (usually Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection) — do not new-up services.
Tests match the client's framework (xUnit/NUnit/MSTest) — detect from existing test project references, never assume xUnit.
prompt_pack.pr_style: Match existing PR titles in the client repo. Default: imperative summary, reference their work item ID (AB#1234 for Azure DevOps, #123 for GitHub).
never: Never add NuGet packages without flagging it in the PR description.
Never touch .sln GUIDs by hand — use dotnet sln commands.
